name: Feira de Produtores Bio
description: Stock up on organic fruit, vegetables, homemade bread, and honey directly from local producers at this scenic city park market.
longDescription:
The Feira de Produtores Bio is a regular market event dedicated to organic produce, bringing together local farmers and artisans. Organised to promote sustainable agriculture and direct sales, it offers a range of certified organic items including seasonal fruits, garden vegetables, freshly baked bread, and various types of honey. This market provides a direct link between consumers and the source of their food, supporting regional producers.

Visitors can expect a relaxed outdoor atmosphere within the expansive green space of Parque da Cidade. The market caters to residents and visitors interested in sourcing fresh, high-quality ingredients and supporting local food systems. The setting in Porto's largest urban park allows for a pleasant morning outing, combining shopping with access to nature.

Entry to the market is free, and no tickets are required. The event takes place on Saturday, September 26, 2026, starting at 08:30. Parque da Cidade is accessible via several bus lines, with stops located near the market area. It is also a significant landmark, easily reachable from various parts of the city.
